load_flow: load optical flow from a .flo binary file or KITTI 16-bit PNG image and return flow data with validity mask
load_mask: load a mask image from disk and return a normalized float32 array with shape HxWx1
resize_flow: resize a batched optical flow tensor to a new spatial shape while scaling displacement values accordingly
writeFlowSintel: write optical flow data to a Sintel-format .flo binary file with u and v channels
evaluate_flow: evaluate predicted optical flow against ground truth by computing EPE and bad pixel error rates
